blocker_evidence.SEALED_HOLDOUT_MEMBERSHIP_PUBLICLY_READA: results/v4/stage81a2_split_registry.csv on public main discloses which donors are in the sealed_holdout split, together with the freeze seed and assignment method. NOT a privacy or PII issue: the owner confirms all donor data was obtained from already-public databases (SEA-AD is published by the Allen Institute), so donor identifiers and pathology are already in the public domain and require no remediation. The remaining issue is narrower and purely one of split concealment: a sealed holdout assumes membership is unknown until the evaluation contract is frozen, so a publicly readable membership list makes a future sealed-evaluation claim contestable regardless of whether anyone looked. Nothing to repair in git; if a sealed-holdout evaluation is proposed later, re-seal with a fresh seed and partition instead.

blocker_evidence.PHASE_E_GRADIENT_CHECK_IS_BLIND_TO_ZERO: phase_e.component_gradient_report counts only missing and nonfinite gradients, never zero. It passed on every C2-v3 run while 48 tensors were dead. This is why the historical T1 run raised no mechanics error. Any successor training path must gate zero per tensor.
blocker_evidence.C2_DEEP_KERNEL_MECHANISM_OPEN: Necessity and sufficiency are established at the code-condition level: disabling autocast only around the backward call restores all 48 tensors at 128/8 with all nine frozen criteria met, while the historical arm still gives 48/48 dead. Why the collapse is to EXACT zero rather than merely inaccurate values is unresolved. The autocast weight cache (I1) and allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction (J1) were both tested and refuted.
blocker_evidence.C2_PRODUCTION_SAFE_REWRITE_NOT_RUN: The production_safe variant currently accumulates every scaled loss and drains the backwards after the autocast block, holding 64 live graphs at 128/8, and will exhaust memory. The autocast region must move inside the view loop to preserve per-view accumulation. Not yet repaired, not yet run, no 128/8 regression.
blocker_evidence.DEC013_SUPERSESSION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_: The DEC-013 characterisation of T1 as having valid mechanics is not defensible in the parameter-wise sense. The historical biological outcome stands: T1 did not qualify biology at u205. Supersession must follow independent C2 verification, not precede it.
